findings.summary: Adding syn needs the root Cargo.toml, which the plan does not list
findings.evidence: Read: the root Cargo.toml has `[workspace.dependencies]` at line 26, and every athena-core dependency is written as `<name>.workspace = true`. The plan says it will add syn and proc-macro2 'to athena-core' and leaves central pinning as an open question. Cargo.lock already has syn 2.0.119 and 3.0.7, and proc-macro2 1.0.107. Fix: List the root Cargo.toml as a deliverable. Add syn (features full, parsing, visit as needed) and proc-macro2 (feature span-locations) under [workspace.dependencies], then use `syn.workspace = true` in athena-core. Pick a syn major version already in Cargo.lock so no third copy is added, and say which one.
findings.location: Plan Files list / Step 1 / Open question 3; Cargo.toml line 26; crates/athena-core/Cargo.toml lines 11-24

findings.summary: The note_finished hook should state that it runs only for landed jobs
findings.evidence: Read: steward.rs:99 returns early when the run is nested or the state is not Landed/Rejected. The plan puts the hook before that check, so as written it would also run for Rejected and Failed outcomes. Fix: Check for OutcomeState::Landed in the hook itself, still before the nested-run return so the nested-run tests exercise it. Add a test showing a Rejected outcome queues nothing.
findings.location: Approach: 'in note_finished in steward.rs ahead of the nested-run/non-landed early return'; steward.rs:98-102

findings.summary: The definition of a landing is left undecided, yet the cadence depends on it
findings.evidence: The plan counts every first-parent commit on HEAD as a landing but asks whether only commits with an Athena-Job trailer should count. Direct pushes or records-only commits would shift when the 10-landing review fires. Fix: Decide before production: for example, count only first-parent commits that carry the Athena-Job trailer. Record the choice in docs/decisions.md and use the same definition in the cadence and 7-day churn tests.

findings.summary: How the test asserts the hook runs after resync_onto_merge and the Pages watch is not stated
findings.evidence: The demonstration says it will 'assert queued request and ordering after resync and Pages watch' but does not name what it observes. A test that only finds a queued request does not show the order. Fix: Name the evidence for the order, such as the Ui lines in sequence, or the queued request's records commit coming after the resync commit on the records branch.

summary: The plan fits the accepted reading and names real places to hook in. Athena::land_pr is at gh.rs:2455, resync_onto_merge at land.rs:190, note_finished at steward.rs:98 (called from go in run.rs:152), and Athena::queue at reading.rs:550. AnyRecord::Baseline already exists (store.rs:184), so the plan correctly adds a separate CodeHealthBaseline variant. The land_pr path and the go/note_finished path are separate (main.rs:982 and drain.rs:1298 call land_pr; go only calls note_finished), so each hook test can fail on its own. Counting landings from git history keeps the count correct when both hooks fire. One major gap: the workspace pins dependencies centrally. The root Cargo.toml has a [workspace.dependencies] table, and every athena-core dependency uses `.workspace = true`. Adding syn and proc-macro2 therefore means editing the root Cargo.toml, which the plan leaves as an open question and does not list. Smaller issues: the note_finished hook is placed before the existing early return without saying it is limited to landed jobs, the definition of a landing is left open, and the ordering assertion in criterion 7 is vague. Verdict: revise.
